facts.text: Serve the mains when Brantley changes from mailroom clothes to his suit in the lift.
facts.why: TV Tropes says Brantley stops the lift to use it as a dressing room when he switches to Carlton Whitfield, so the elevator change is a real recurring gag.

facts.text: Lean times call for a proper lunch. Charges go to your department. Elevators are not changing rooms.
facts.why: The elevator changing gag is confirmed, and a note signed by Howard Prescott about charging lunch to a department fits the takeover plot.

vibe.verdict: A smart executive dining room with a good routing slip, but it leaves out the quick changes and the bedroom pile up.
